name: render-deploys
description: A /render-deploys pane of your recent Render deploys: state, service, environment, branch, commit, trigger, age and link, with the current git branch highlighted

services.title: Render services
services.description: Comma-separated Render service names to show. Empty shows every service, up to the service cap.

max_services.title: Service cap
max_services.description: Most services to list deploys for. A full refresh makes one request per service.

max_rows.title: Rows
max_rows.description: How many deploys to list, newest first.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the open pane refreshes every service. Also the longest gap between full refreshes while something builds.

building_refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval while building (seconds)
building_refresh_seconds.description: How often the pane re-checks the services that have a deploy building.

notify_on_finish.title: Toast when a branch deploy finishes
notify_on_finish.description: With the pane closed, keep watching deploys of the current git branch that were building and show a toast when each one is live or fails.
